subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class skill configuration action to `SKILL.md` metadata, and what URL/button trust contract should the dashboard enforce?
rationale: This is a new public skill metadata and clickable dashboard URL surface; code inspection cannot choose the product semantics or security boundary safely without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve typed config action
options.body: Add a typed configuration action with explicit allowed URL schemes/origins, trust labeling, default label behavior, docs, and UI/API tests.

options.title: Use existing link surfaces
options.body: Keep `homepage`, Skill Card, and ClawHub as the supported discovery paths and document that skills should link configuration pages there.

options.title: Defer to plugin or ClawHub settings
options.body: Do not add core skill frontmatter fields until a broader plugin/ClawHub settings model exists.

recommendation.title: Approve typed config action
recommendation.body: Add a typed configuration action with explicit allowed URL schemes/origins, trust labeling, default label behavior, docs, and UI/API tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history on skill docs and shared URL helper behavior, and the remaining choice is primarily product/security policy.
